interpretations: For each store, compare each rental’s total linked payments with the average rental payment total at that store; report the sum of qualifying rental totals and their average monetary excess.
For each store, compare each rental’s total linked payments with the average rental payment total across all stores; report the sum of qualifying rental totals and their average monetary excess.
Under either comparison, report only stores with qualifying rentals.
Under either comparison, report every store, using a zero sum and a missing average excess where no rentals qualify.
Compute the average rental payment total over all rentals, treating rentals with no linked payments as having a total of zero.
queries:
WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT
    i.store_id,
    r.rental_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS payment_total
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id
),
store_averages AS (
  SELECT store_id, AVG(payment_total) AS average_payment_total
  FROM rental_totals
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT
  rt.store_id,
  SUM(rt.payment_total) AS qualifying_total,
  AVG(rt.payment_total - sa.average_payment_total) AS average_monetary_excess
FROM rental_totals AS rt
JOIN store_averages AS sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id
WHERE rt.payment_total > sa.average_payment_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id

WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT
    i.store_id,
    r.rental_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS payment_total
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(payment_total) AS payment_total FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT
  rt.store_id,
  SUM(rt.payment_total) AS qualifying_payment_total,
  AVG(rt.payment_total - oa.payment_total) AS average_monetary_excess
FROM rental_totals AS rt
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE rt.payment_total > oa.payment_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id

SELECT AVG(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount)
                     FROM payment AS p
                     WHERE p.rental_id = r.rental_id), 0)) AS average_rental_payment_total
FROM rental AS r
